scope: non-wire design expectations; no real crypto/native vectors

cases.input: fresh supported QR; explicit existing installation; current canonical HA context; valid proof
cases.required_behavior: separate six-digit HA approval still required

cases.input: camera permission denied
cases.required_behavior: offer settings or explicit retry; no submit

cases.input: valid QR; no current HA pairing
cases.required_behavior: do not promote guest to owner

cases.input: two supported paired installations; none selected
cases.required_behavior: no last-used automatic selection

cases.input: cached remote URL; current owner context unavailable
cases.required_behavior: cached URL never grants scan-time release

cases.input: transport context differs from selected install ID
cases.required_behavior: discard prepared payload

cases.input: HTTP/IP/custom port/query/fragment/IDNA/escaped or slash alias
cases.required_behavior: reject before normalization; no downgrade

cases.input: pairing/Profile changes then returns while awaiting
cases.required_behavior: monotone flow generation remains invalid

cases.input: owner context origin or issuer epoch changes after confirmation
cases.required_behavior: discard proof and require fresh explicit confirmation

cases.input: old submit callback after a new browser generation
cases.required_behavior: never show old success or start HA admission

cases.input: same current QR scanned twice
cases.required_behavior: one deliberate submission; no new consent

cases.input: original QR deadline reached while preparing
cases.required_behavior: no renewed original deadline; explicit fresh scan

cases.input: unknown/invalid key or equal/lower counter
cases.required_behavior: no unsigned fallback; exact error privacy preserved

cases.input: Mac or isSupported false
cases.required_behavior: use supported paired iPhone or existing non-A route

cases.input: Apple request temporarily unavailable
cases.required_behavior: bounded explicit retry inside original expiry

cases.input: submission may have committed; reply lost
cases.required_behavior: only frozen safe recovery; no blind resubmit or remote recall claim

cases.input: TV lost one-time consume reply
cases.required_behavior: fresh QR; no repeat secret collection

cases.input: different genuine attested app with own valid paired HA wins first submit
cases.required_behavior: app validity cannot prove intended TV owner; no invented reject capability

cases.input: user cancels while submit completion delayed
cases.required_behavior: ignore local late callbacks; cannot promise address recall

cases.input: HA returns display_external_url_unavailable
cases.required_behavior: do not use new internal LAN IP for A

cases.input: A delivered address; six-digit HA admission denied/revoked
cases.required_behavior: no display content or Session grant

cases.input: separate actual HA claim/consent/approval/collection succeeded
cases.required_behavior: only B authoritative response admits display
